title: Every check green while quality decays
caption: HTTP 200, p99 inside budget, 99.99% uptime — and accuracy sliding 94% toward 88%. Infrastructure health and model health are different instruments.

title: Where ML technical debt hides
caption: The model is ~5% of the code; the debt lives around it — boundary erosion, correction cascades, undeclared consumers, feedback loops, config sprawl and glue.

title: Which model answers the request?
caption: In shadow mode, both models can see a request and the incumbent supplies the reply. In this illustrative 5% canary, the router assigns one request in twenty on average to the candidate for a real reply. Full rollout moves all replies to the candidate. Rollback routes new requests back to the incumbent.

title: The interval that pays for itself
caption: Staleness accrues as accuracy decays; each run restores it for a fixed cost. The optimal interval sits where amortized run cost meets accrued staleness.

title: The closed operations loop
caption: Deploy, monitor, detect, diagnose, retrain, release — the loop turns a static artifact into a maintained claim.
